versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes.
- Internal update: Modified clip.sh only; documentation remains unchanged.
Fix option injection: add -- before URL in yt-dlp calls; validate START/END time format

- Added cleanup step: deletes the full raw downloaded video after clipping.
- Minor wording changes to the skill description for clarity.

- Clarified that any video URL from YouTube can be used, not just the highest quality.
- Updated wording to emphasize flexible start and end times for clipping.
- Specified that clips are always saved to ~/Desktop/Clips.
- No functional changes; documentation improvements only.

- Minor update to clip.sh script.
- No changes to skill description or usage instructions.

Initial release of the "clip" skill.

- Downloads highest quality video from YouTube.
- Clips a specified time range from the video.
- Saves the resulting video with working audio to ~/Desktop/Clips.
- Supports custom file naming and both timestamp or seconds-based clipping.
